title: Word Count & Reading Time Display
description: Add live word count and reading time to the editor footer using TipTap CharacterCount extension
action: Install @tiptap/extension-character-count@^3.22.0. Add CharacterCount to NikoEditor useEditor extensions array. In the existing onUpdate callback, extract word count via editor.storage.characterCount.words() and character count via editor.storage.characterCount.characters(). Compute readingTime as Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wordCount / 200)). Pass wordCount and readingTime as new props to AppContextFooter. Update AppContextFooter interface to accept wordCount?: number and readingTime?: number. Display format: '{wordCount} words · {readingTime} min read' in the footer bar, only when wordCount > 0.

convergence.verification: Run npx vitest run to verify all tests pass. Check AppContextFooter renders word count when wordCount prop > 0.
convergence.definition_of_done: Word count and reading time displayed in editor footer, updating live as user types

files.change: Import CharacterCount from @tiptap/extension-character-count, add to extensions array. In onUpdate callback, extract word count via editor.storage.characterCount.words() and pass to parent via new callback prop.
Add wordCount?: number and readingTime?: number to props interface. Display '{wordCount} words · {readingTime} min read' when wordCount > 0.

implementation: In NikoEditor.tsx: add CharacterCount to useEditor({ extensions: [StarterKit, ..., CharacterCount] })
In NikoEditor.tsx onUpdate: add const words = ed.storage.characterCount?.words() ?? 0; const readingTime = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(words / 200))
Pass words and readingTime to parent component via existing or new callback prop
In AppContextFooter.tsx: add wordCount?: number and readingTime?: number to AppContextFooterProps
In AppContextFooter.tsx: render word count section when wordCount > 0: '{wordCount} words · {readingTime} min read'
Run: npx vitest run to verify no regressions

unit: AppContextFooter renders word count when wordCount prop provided
AppContextFooter renders reading time when readingTime prop provided
AppContextFooter hides word count when wordCount is 0 or undefined
